name: CnT-processing
description: CUT&Tag processing: FASTQ to normalized bigWigs, counts, SEACR peaks and QC

bowtie2_index.help: Bowtie2 index prefix (leave empty to use the shared Fred Hutch index for the genome)

min_mapq.help: Minimum mapping quality of kept read pairs

keep_chrM.help: Keep the mitochondrial contig in the fragments and the genome size

promoter_window.help: Promoter window: protein-coding TSS +/- this many bp

plot_window.help: Window (+/- bp) around TSSs and peak summits in the deepTools plots

optical_pixel_distance.help: Picard optical duplicate pixel distance: 2500 for patterned flow cells, 100 for unpatterned

readcount_scaled_bw.help: Also make read-count scaled bigWigs (assumes equal cell input and equal-volume pooling)

dedup_controls.help: Use deduplicated IgG control fragments for SEACR

blacklist_filter.help: Remove fragments that overlap the ENCODE blacklist v2
